description.fallback: One night, Kakyoin hears a baby crying and finds himself riding a Ferris wheel in an amusement park, wearing his pajamas. He tells himself that he should be in Saudi Arabia crossing the desert, and looks over to see a dog sitting next to him. He then finds a balloon, which is carrying a card with a picture of a sinister looking clown with a scythe.
